_comment: Landing inside the cone under a bounded disturbance (UE-bCBF) with the stock-x500 limits (thrust 1.99-14.95 m/s^2, roll/pitch +-3.84 rad/s, yaw +-0.203 rad/s; cone 45 deg, r0 0.3 m, floor, base set c_B 15.1: docker_batch/configs/landing_x500_cone45_r0p3.json). Backup: the plain x500 Phase-I safe-arrival policy (input x only; the best of the x500 Phase-I runs, the 'SA-plain' choice of the outside-cone comparison), used blind to d_hat inside the UE filter. Reference: corner-cut slowed for the x500 (4 s from (-1.6, 0, 2) m, peak 1.53 m/s, tilt 8.9 deg). Disturbance: 0.5 m/s^2 as in the 4 g study, but at 0.025 Hz (rate bound delta_v 0.079 m/s^3). At 0.05 Hz (delta_v 0.157, the first version of this file) the tube left the backup no way to reach the tightened base set from the last 0.2 m above the pad, so the filter could not let the vehicle land (scripts/check_landing_ue_task.py). Read by scripts/train_phase2_landing_ue_cached.py --task and docker_batch/run_landing_ue_twostage.sh; see docker_batch/README_x500_ue.md.
